title: 实验 3-7 · 三要素法 + 戴维宁：电容旁边并一个电阻
summary: 在 RC 电路的电容两端再并一个 10 kΩ：终值减半、时间常数也减半。再学一个用示波器读数反算 τ 的办法。
concepts: 戴维宁等效电阻 Thévenin resistance
由 VH/VL 求 τ measuring τ from the swing
description: **要搭的电路**：信号发生器红夹子 → R1（10 kΩ）→ 结点 VC；VC 到 GND 之间并联 C1（100 nF）和 R2（10 kΩ）。黑夹子接 GND。
**信号发生器**：方波，幅度 2.5 V、偏置 2.5 V（0 ↔ 5 V）。**示波器**：CH1 看 VIN，CH2 看 VC。
- **终值 u(∞)**：电容开路，R1 和 R2 分压。R1 要加上信号发生器的 50 Ω：u(∞) = 5 V × 10 k / (10.05 k + 10 k) ≈ 2.49 V——不是 5 V！
- **时间常数 τ = R_eq·C**：R_eq 是从电容两端看进去的戴维宁电阻（电压源置零）：R_eq = (10.05 k) ∥ (10 k) ≈ 5.01 kΩ，所以 τ ≈ 5.01 kΩ × 100 nF ≈ 0.50 ms。只有 RC 串联时的一半！
- **初值 u(0+)**：电容电压不能突变，等于上一个半周期结束时的值。
放电半周期也一样：方波为 0 V 时 u(∞) = 0，从电容看进去还是 R1 ∥ R2，τ 不变。
**100 Hz（半周期 5 ms ≈ 10τ）**：每次都走到终值，VC 在 0 和 ≈ 2.49 V 之间。
**1 kHz（半周期 0.5 ms ≈ τ）**：VC 在 VL ≈ 0.67 V 和 VH ≈ 1.82 V 之间来回，中心是 u(∞)/2 ≈ 1.25 V。

**用读数反算 τ**：放电半周期从 VH 指数衰减到 0 的过程中，经过 T/2 时恰好到 VL，所以 VL = VH·e^(−T/(2τ))，即 τ = (T/2) / ln(VH/VL) = 0.5 ms / ln(1.82/0.67) ≈ 0.50 ms。这个办法不需要知道终值，也不需要从 0 开始，任何频率都能用（2 kHz 时 VH ≈ 1.55 V、VL ≈ 0.94 V，算出来还是 ≈ 0.50 ms）。
**动手**：在板上测出 VH、VL，自己算一次 τ；然后把 R2 拔掉，猜一猜 VH、VL 会变成多少（提示：回到实验 3-1 的情况，τ 变成 ≈ 1 ms，终值 5 V）。

en.title: Experiment 3-7 · Three-element method + Thévenin: a resistor across the capacitor
en.summary: Add a 10 kΩ across the capacitor of an RC circuit: the final value halves and so does the time constant. Plus a way to work out τ from scope readings.
concepts: measuring τ from the swing VH/VL
description: **What you build**: generator red clip → R1 (10 kΩ) → node VC; between VC and GND, C1 (100 nF) and R2 (10 kΩ) in parallel. Black clip to GND.
**Generator**: square wave, amplitude 2.5 V, offset 2.5 V (0 ↔ 5 V). **Scope**: CH1 on VIN, CH2 on VC.
**Three-element method**: u_C(t) = u(∞) + [u(0+) − u(∞)]·e^(−t/τ); find each element:
- **Final value u(∞)**: capacitor open, R1 and R2 form a divider. Add the generator's 50 Ω to R1: u(∞) = 5 V × 10 k / (10.05 k + 10 k) ≈ 2.49 V — not 5 V!

- **Time constant τ = R_eq·C**: R_eq is the Thévenin resistance seen from the capacitor's terminals (sources set to zero): R_eq = (10.05 k) ∥ (10 k) ≈ 5.01 kΩ, so τ ≈ 5.01 kΩ × 100 nF ≈ 0.50 ms — half of the plain series RC!
- **Initial value u(0+)**: the capacitor voltage cannot jump, so it is the value at the end of the previous half period.
The discharging half period works the same way: with the square wave at 0 V, u(∞) = 0 and the capacitor still sees R1 ∥ R2, so τ is unchanged.
**100 Hz (half period 5 ms ≈ 10τ)**: the final value is reached every time; VC swings between 0 and ≈ 2.49 V.
**1 kHz (half period 0.5 ms ≈ τ)**: VC swings between VL ≈ 0.67 V and VH ≈ 1.82 V, centred on u(∞)/2 ≈ 1.25 V.

**Working τ out from the readings**: discharging from VH towards 0, the voltage reaches exactly VL after T/2, so VL = VH·e^(−T/(2τ)), i.e. τ = (T/2) / ln(VH/VL) = 0.5 ms / ln(1.82/0.67) ≈ 0.50 ms. You don't need the final value or a start from 0, and it works at any frequency (at 2 kHz, VH ≈ 1.55 V and VL ≈ 0.94 V still give ≈ 0.50 ms).
**Try it**: read VH and VL on your board and compute τ yourself; then pull R2 out and predict the new VH and VL (hint: you're back to Experiment 3-1, τ ≈ 1 ms, final value 5 V).
hints: C1 and R2 both go from VC to GND, side by side.
Final value: a divider of (R1 + 50 Ω) and R2. τ: (R1 + 50 Ω) ∥ R2, times C.
tests: 100 Hz: final value u(∞) ≈ 2.49 V (not 5 V), discharges to ≈ 0
1 kHz: VH ≈ 1.82 V, VL ≈ 0.67 V → τ = (T/2)/ln(VH/VL) ≈ 0.50 ms
2 kHz: VH ≈ 1.55 V, VL ≈ 0.94 V, average still ≈ 1.25 V

tests.name: 100 Hz：终值 u(∞) ≈ 2.49 V（不是 5 V），放电到 ≈ 0

hints: C1 和 R2 都从 VC 接到 GND，并排放。
终值：(R1 + 50 Ω) 和 R2 分压；τ：(R1 + 50 Ω) ∥ R2，再乘 C。
